dse-ac-rcbo.note: The purchased CHTAIXI B0CSV93CTN is 120 V Type AC and cannot substitute. Use a two-pole 230 V, 10 A, 30 mA Type A RCBO selected and tested by the qualified installer.

dse-ac-enclosure.note: Choose the compact enclosure, DIN rail and strain relief only after confirming the RCBO dimensions and the qualified installer's termination plan.

dse-tool-lead.sourceLabel: Bunnings Pacific Fiji · HPM 5 m workshop lead

dse-gen-input.sourceLabel: Verify the actual G3200P, then assemble in Fiji
dse-gen-input.note: Do not order an assumed Type I lead from Amazon. This G3200P model is sold with market-specific receptacles and the Fiji listing image is not conclusive. Inspect the actual outlet, then fit one matching male plug to a three-core lead whose other end is hardwired to MultiPlus AC-in. No inlet box is required.

dse-switch-internet.note: Exact DPST OFF–ON Contura switch. Amazon's generic page title is unhelpful, but the listing specifies double-pole/single-throw, 15 A at 24 VDC, salt-spray resistance and compatibility with Blue Sea Contura mounting panels.

dse-switch-lights.time: Amazon exact model · $14.99 each when checked
dse-switch-lights.note: Buy two exact SPST OFF–ON Contura switches. The listing specifies 15 A at 24 VDC, salt-spray resistance and compatibility with the existing Blue Sea Contura frame.

dse-switch-frame.note: Exact three-position frame was $10.80 and shipping immediately when checked.

dse-switch-accessories.note: No single kit matches the jack, diode, gasket, labeling and terminal requirements. Verify the jack polarity and current rating; buy six 1N5408-class diodes so two remain as spares.

dse-indoor-light.note: One of three purchased ASIN B0F1V59NXC fixtures. Install indoors on a short dry bracket with the lens aimed down. Add two series 3 A silicon diodes to keep its input below 28 V during GEL absorption.

dse-outdoor-light.note: One of three purchased ASIN B0F1V59NXC fixtures. Add two series 3 A silicon diodes for charge-voltage margin. Install under an eave with 316 stainless replacement fasteners and sealed bedding; this low-cost fixture has no demonstrated Hella-equivalent salt-spray rating.

dse-light-spare.note: Third identical fixture, carried as a direct spare rather than connected as another load.

dse-light-install.note: Site-measured cable and mounting consumables are intentionally local; confirm UV, moisture and corrosion suitability.

dse-earth.note: This allowance covers the electrode, bonding conductors, lugs, corrosion protection and testing—not the busbar. The exact eight-position Blue Sea 2128 is a separate BOM row.

dse-terms.note: Amazon stocks lugs and adhesive heat-shrink, but this row also needs verified lug sizes, ferrules, glands, genuine-compatible MC4 parts, ties and labels.

dse-battery-rack.note: Stainless-hardware straps are available; the low rack/base and fitted terminal covers remain local fabrication.

dse-breaker-mnepv20.note: Retain the exact 10 kA MidNite MNEPV20 on the direct battery bus. The $8.99 CHTAIXI B20 is listed for low-short-circuit-current applications and lacks documented series coordination for this role.
